inputs.name: deliveryMode
inputs.label: Send mode
inputs.helpText: Async queues the email and lets the workflow continue. Choose wait only when a following step needs the provider message ID.

inputs.name: recipientMode
inputs.label: Recipients

options.label: One private email per matching row

inputs.helpText: Use the private mode after Filter Rows to send each matching row its own email. It always queues delivery asynchronously.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.label: Matching rows
inputs.placeholder: Connect Filter Rows, or insert row objects from a previous step with {}
inputs.helpText: Leave this empty to use the connected Filter Rows output.

inputs.name: recipientColumn
inputs.label: Recipient email column
inputs.helpText: The exact header from the matching rows. Column matching ignores letter case.

inputs.name: to
inputs.label: To (recipient email)
inputs.placeholder: user@example.com or insert data from a previous step with {}

inputs.name: subject
inputs.label: Subject
inputs.placeholder: Hello [Name], your order is ready — use [[Column]] for one email per row

inputs.name: body
inputs.label: Email Body
inputs.placeholder:
Hi [Name],

Your order has shipped.

Use [[Column]] for one email per row.

outputs.name: messageId
outputs.label: Message ID
outputs.description: The ID returned by the email provider after sending. Available only when Send mode is set to Wait for delivery.

outputs.name: deliveryId
outputs.label: Delivery ID
outputs.description: The durable ID for an asynchronous email delivery.

outputs.name: recipientCount
outputs.label: Private recipient count
outputs.description: The number of unique row recipients that received their own queued email.
